name: Conversation Tools
description: Agent tools for conversation questions, inspection, titles, and working directory changes.

tools.name: ask_user
tools.title: Ask User
tools.description: Ask the user one or more focused questions in the desktop UI.
tools.promptSnippet: Ask the user structured questions with buttons, radio choices, or checkboxes.
promptGuidelines: Ask only when blocked on a real decision or approval. Prefer questions[] for structured choices.

question.description: Legacy single-question form. Use questions[] for multiple questions or check-style questions.

details.description: Optional overall context, or legacy single-question context when question is used alone.

options.description: Legacy quick-reply options for a single-question prompt.

questions.description: Structured questions to render in the desktop UI. Prefer this for multiple questions and radio/check layouts.

details.description: Optional supporting context for this question.

style.description: radio for one choice, check/checkbox for multi-select.

value.description: Stable value sent back when selected.

label.description: User-facing option label. Defaults to value.

details.description: Optional supporting text shown under the option.
